section_summary.extract_value: This section reports a single study (Study X) of 490 women from the Portuguese general population. Participants were aged 18–54 (M = 24.76, SD = 7.66) and had a mean BMI of 22.29 (SD = 3.87); BMI categories were 53 underweight (10.82%), 349 normal weight (71.22%), and 88 overweight (17.96%).
section_summary.evidence_source: Full paragraph: "Four hundred and ninety women were collected from the Portuguese general population, with ages ranging from 18 to 54 years old (M = 24.76; SD = 7.66). Participants presented a Body Mass Index (BMI) mean of 22.29 (SD = 3.87) ... Fifty-three (10.82%) were underweight ..., 349 (71.22%) ... and 88 (17.96%) were overweight ..."
